name: Igede
notes: Placed so the ancestry graph covers every living ISO 639-3 language. No orthography is claimed; the phoneme inventory follows the cited PHOIBLE inventory (which itself cites a published description): script is Zyyy (undetermined) until a cited description is encoded. Classification and coordinates follow Glottolog. Orthography from Hartell 1993, Alphabets of Africa (UNESCO/SIL), extracted via the AfriSpeech/africa-g2p compilation (ige.json). africa-g2p is a compilation tool, not the linguistic authority; the citation above is the original source it names.
